description: This data pack gives the player simple status effects when wearing a full set of any armor trimmed with any smithing template.
body:
# Simple Trim Effects

This data pack give simple status effects when you wear a full set of any armor trimmed with any smithing template. The effects are based on the material used. This data pack is made for the best performance, so it works well on server with multiple players.

### Here is the lsit of effects and their meterials:

- **Emerald**: Hero of the Village 2
- **Redstone**: Regeneration 1
- **Lapis**: Luck 1
- **Amethyst**: Speed 1
- **Quartz**: Health Boost 3 (6 extra hearts)
- **Netherite**: Fire Resistance
- **Diamond**: Resistance 1
- **Gold**: Haste 1
- **Iron**: Strength 1
- **Copper**: Water Breathing
